# vyos.blueprints.bridge_firewall

Bridges with bridge and IPv4 firewall (docs blueprint "Bridge and firewall example")

- Per bridge, creates the bridge and its members, an interface group `<bridge>-ifaces`, bridge-firewall rulesets `<bridge>-pre` (prerouting) and `<bridge>-fwd` (forward) with the jump rules that select them, and optionally an IPv4 ruleset `ip-<bridge>-fwd` for routed traffic and an input rule for access to the router - the structure used on the docs page.
- Bridges, interface groups and the bridge firewall use vyos.vyos.vyos_config, because vyos.vyos has no resource modules for them yet. Member descriptions and the IPv4 firewall use resource modules.

## Usage

```yaml
- hosts: routers
  gather_facts: false
  roles:
    - vyos.blueprints.bridge_firewall
```

| `bridge_firewall_bridges.name` | str | yes |  | Bridge interface, e.g. `br1`. |
| `bridge_firewall_bridges.description` | str |  |  | Bridge description. |

## Entry point `verify` (`tasks_from: verify`)

Run with `tasks_from=verify`. Checks bridge membership and that the bridge rulesets are active.

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bridge_firewall_bridges` | list | yes |  | Same value as for `main`. |
